images.title: Four steps up the power line of 7
images.purpose: Shows 343 × 2401 on the power line of 7 as a move of 4 steps up from 7³ to 7⁷, which is 823543.
images.composition: Plain white background, the main object large and centred with wide empty margins, no scenery, no characters, no extra decoration. One horizontal line with eight evenly spaced dots and one curved arrow going forward.
images.exact_structure: One horizontal line in dark outline with exactly 8 evenly spaced teal (#0072B2) dots for 7⁰ up to 7⁷ from left to right, with no labels except two: the fourth dot 7³ = 343 below it, and the eighth dot 7⁷ = 823543 below it, this last dot reddish purple (#CC79A7). One amber (#E69F00) curved arrow above the line from the 7³ dot to the 7⁷ dot, labelled × 2401: 4 steps up. Under the line, centred, the label 3 + 4 = 7. Nothing else.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: Multiplying by 7⁴ on the power line moves 4 steps up: 343 × 2401 = 7⁷.
images.description: Shows 343 × 2401 on the power line of 7 as a move of 4 steps up from 7³ to 7⁷, which is 823543.

image_decisions.why: The practice works on the power line of 7, and this shows one product as a move along it.
